en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit

Ohhh, the game where you throw a ball into a
basket, right? We have that game on my island.

But on my island, the losing team is
sacrificed.

And once you're chosen as a sacrifice, you
can't be unchosen.

I don't feel like being sacrificed today so
I think I'm gonna pass.

Nyahaha! Then let's take each other's
clothes off!

Don't worry! I got a lotta experience takin'
clothes off!
There are no clothes I can't take off!
Nyahahaha! That's some wise thinkin', Shuichi.

Atua says the most important thing anyone
can do is be prepared.

Atua says he didn't prepare enough when he
created the world. That's why it's not perfect.
Nyahahaha! Isn't it cute how clumsy Atua is?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
